verdict.rationale: n8n has a first-party documentation page titled "Use the command line" under its self-hosting configuration docs, and a probe confirms an official CLI is documented there. The pack gives only the page title, with no detail on commands or how they serve AI-native or agent workflows, so only the CLI's existence is shown. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and scope (e.g. workflow export/import or execution from the terminal), evidence of agent-friendly or AI-native CLI use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
